_README: Single source of truth for every image on the site.
An image is PUBLISHED only when it has:  approved: true  AND  a non-empty credit.
check_site.py fails the build on any image referenced in HTML that does not meet
both conditions. This is what enforces the client rules:
- every photograph and artwork carries a named artist
published  - approved, credited, live on the site
held       - the file is fine, but the photographer's name is unknown.
Listed in CREDITS-NEEDED.md. Publishes the moment a name lands.
Add new images with tools/import_photos.py; do not hand-edit the entries it writes.
